name: Starberry
description: A small berry crop found within the Starberry forest. Starberries can be grown and used in custom recipes.
lore: Said to have first sprouted where a fallen star touched the forest floor.

name: Strawberry
description: A sweet custom berry used in several desserts and drinks.
lore: A little taste of summer, even beneath the forest canopy.

name: Vanilla Bean
description: A fragrant custom crop used to flavor desserts and sweets.
lore: Its gentle fragrance lingers long after the pod is picked.

name: Tomato
description: A versatile custom crop used in many savory recipes.
lore: Warm sunlight seems to follow these bright red fruits wherever they grow.

name: Grape
description: A sweet custom fruit used for drinks and other recipes.
lore: Small, sweet, and happiest growing beneath a quiet afternoon sun.

name: Broccoli
description: A custom vegetable used in fresh meal recipes.
lore: A sturdy little harvest from the greener corners of the forest.

name: Green Bean
description: A custom vegetable used in fresh meal recipes.
lore: Tender vines curl toward anything willing to help them climb.

name: Cauliflower
description: A custom vegetable used in fresh meal recipes.
lore: A pale garden bloom hiding beneath broad green leaves.

name: Cucumber
description: A crisp custom vegetable used in fresh meal recipes.
lore: Cool and crisp, as though it still remembers the morning dew.

name: Bell Pepper
description: A colorful custom vegetable used in savory meals.
lore: A colorful harvest with a satisfying forest-grown crunch.

name: Rice
description: A custom staple crop used in several meals and desserts.
lore: Tiny grains gathered from fields where shallow water reflects the stars.

name: Garlic
description: A custom seasoning crop used in savory recipes.
lore: Its unmistakable aroma has a habit of reaching the kitchen before you do.

name: Yellow Garlic
description: A custom ingredient used in fried rice.
lore: A golden-tinted variety prized by cooks for its warm, mellow flavor.

name: Cabbage
description: A leafy custom crop used in hearty meals.
lore: Layer upon layer of crisp leaves wrapped tightly around its heart.

name: Pepper
description: A custom crop used to add flavor to savory foods.
lore: A little forest-grown heat for anyone brave enough to bite.

name: Onion
description: A custom crop used throughout Starberry cooking.
lore: Humble, dependable, and responsible for more watery eyes than any monster.

name: Kiwi
description: A sweet custom fruit used in fresh recipes.
lore: Rough on the outside, bright and surprisingly sweet within.

name: Pineapple
description: A tropical custom fruit used in fresh recipes.
lore: A strangely tropical visitor that somehow found a home in Starberry.

name: Blueberry
description: A custom berry used in fruit-based recipes.
lore: Tiny blue berries that look almost like pieces of the evening sky.

name: Blackberry
description: A custom berry used in fruit-based recipes.
lore: Dark berries gathered where brambles grow thick beneath the trees.

name: Cotton
description: A custom crop used in special recipes and crafting.
lore: So soft it looks as though someone planted a handful of clouds.

name: Lettuce
description: A leafy custom crop used in sandwiches and burgers.
lore: Fresh leaves with the satisfying crunch of a newly tended garden.

name: Red Onion
description: A custom onion variety used in burgers and other savory foods.
lore: Brightly colored layers with a sharper bite than its quieter cousin.
